$comment: MEASURED on 2026-09-10 with tokens/paper-check.html, tile size 220x130 in the browser. Transcribed by hand, because the measurement needs a rendering and no script can produce it.
whyThisFileExists: A cross-check of the colophon card reported that the figure 'luminance deviation at most 0.06 percent' stood in no file of the repo. That was true: the value was measured, but never written down anywhere. A number that only stood in a browser window is, for any surface, a claim — exactly the rule the content model for usage figures already knows.
method: SVG filter rendered per sheet, rasterised via canvas, WCAG luminance per pixel, mean against the flat ground tone. Anisotropy via directional energy, horizontal versus vertical.
bashplotNote: seed 4963 instead of 4962: the original sheet measured 1.1542x and thereby missed the isotropy limit. The offset is recorded in tokens/paper.mjs under SEED_NUDGE, with the measurement log for offsets 0 to 8.
